option_relations.rationale: Ventricular tachycardia is an arrhythmia, while the leaf describes a specific type of heart failure. There is no direct clinical relationship between the two as the option is not a cause, manifestation, or treatment of the leaf.

Dual tachycardia: Atrial flutter with accelerated idioventricular rhythm (AIVR) is a specific arrhythmia, not directly related to the diagnosis of acute decompensated heart failure due to ischemic cardiomyopathy as a cause, manifestation, or treatment.

Atrial tachycardia is an arrhythmia, while the leaf describes a specific type of heart failure. There is no direct clinical relationship between the two as the option is not a cause, manifestation, or treatment of the leaf.

Dual tachyarrhythmias (atrial tachycardia plus slow ventricular tachycardia) is an arrhythmia, not directly related to the diagnosis of acute decompensated heart failure due to ischemic cardiomyopathy as a cause, manifestation, or treatment.
